decisions.reason: The updated Flat Plan changes the issue structure reference but does not change the required polished, modern, brand-aligned visual style.
The updated Flat Plan does not change the requirement to improve image quality with AI when necessary.
The updated Flat Plan does not alter the Civic Lantern website as the source of article content.
The updated Flat Plan does not remove or modify the requirement that articles include the author's name and photo.
The updated Flat Plan does not change the required small circular presentation of author photos.
The revised issue structure does not change the required interactive PDF deliverable for the digital flipbook.
The latest Flat Plan informs issue assembly but does not change the independent requirement to create a magazine layout template.
The updated Flat Plan neither resumes nor changes the deferred print-ready output requirement or its prepress specifications.
